newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom wins Portugues railways order.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom wins Portugues railways order.

text.p: GEC Alsthom said that it had won an order worth 110 million ecu to supply Portuguese National Railways and Gabinette do No Ferrovario de Lisboa with 18 double-deck trainsets for the city of Lisbon.
The trains will be used on a new 18 km-long railway line running north-south crossing the "25 April Bridge" over the River Tagus, which will link the suburban rail network with Lisbon's metro system.
Portuguese companies EFACEC and SOFRAME will be involved in the manufacture of the trains, scheduled to enter service in 1998.
GEC Alsthom is a joint-venture of Alcatel Alsthom and GEC Plc.
